question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Regular'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• Irregular- occurring at uneven or varying rates or intervals.
 
• Intermittent - occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady.
 
• Regular - done or happening frequently.
 
• Improper - not in accordance with accepted standards, especially of morality or honesty.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would reflect the constant training that is necessary for the staff.
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that Regular is the appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - **(1) Rapid changes in science and technology lead to modernisation of technology as well as upgradation of knowledge. In order to upgrade or modernise technology, management must (2) persuade employees to accept new technology. (3) Regular training of staff becomes necessary to update their knowledge and to (4) enhance their skills. This is possible only (5) through effective communication between the management and the employees.*
